prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Specific wait-step status indicators (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful, with predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) slightly too low, though other wait-info additions and new screens showed no clear effect.
Selected layout redesigns (Story Scroll Path Discovery Layout: +9.5% measured) and hints (System Tray Quick Action Callout Tip: +9.6% measured) were helpful, and predictions (-1.0% and +2.0%) were significantly too low.
Most other redesigns, layout changes, and hints showed no clear effect, with positive predictions (+1.0% to +12.0%) consistently being too high.
Deferring account sign-in (-7.3% measured) and path outcome copy optimization (-6.6% measured) significantly harmed performance; predictions (+15.0% and +1.5%) were far too high.
Copy refinements showed no clear effect (or significantly harmed performance), and predictions were generally too optimistic.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +1.3% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +9.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -3.4% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +9.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +5.9% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +0.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.5% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.3%

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Teaser Screen: Adds a new screen during pet creation waiting period where users can interact with pet behavior previews and sound samples. (why: The waiting stage in the home step has a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s). Interactive preview elements keep users engaged while waiting for desktop pet generation.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Story Introduction Subflow: Inserts a new narrative origin selection screen before the path choice step to build early emotional connection. (why: The choose_path step loses 20% of users right at the beginning. An immersive origin story subflow increases early commitment.)
2: [finish, redesign] Compact Card Home Intro Redesign: Rebuilds the home introduction screen into a compact card layout featuring an active mascot greeting and clear setup steps. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or view the pet after onboarding, and completion at finish is 73.2%. A compact mascot-focused screen clarifies desktop controls.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Upload Guidelines Screen: Adds a visual guide screen before photo upload displaying ideal photo lighting and framing examples for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results. Visual guidance upfront reduces generation errors.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Preparation Timer: Adds a live countdown timer display and progress indicator to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s). Lessons showed specific wait status indicators (+14.7%) improve completion.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Sync Status Callout Tip: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in automatically syncs existing pets and account data. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again. Explicit sync reassurance reduces sign-in anxiety.)
6: [home, notification] Generation Completion Desktop Notification Toggle: Enables desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen to alert users when pet generation is complete. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s (over 38 minutes). System notifications prevent drop-off when users minimize the app while waiting.)
7: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Confirmation Headline: Updates the adoption certificate headline and call-to-action button to highlight official companion naming. (why: Adoption stage conversion is 68.2% with 89s median time. Reassuring copy clarifies the naming step before generation.)

scores.note: Home step drop-off is low (13%), and previous home new screens yielded only +1.2% lift.
